create_tensorbox_ir_node: create a TensorBox IR node to represent a PyTorch tensor in the Inductor compiler
build_reduction_kernel: build a Reduction IR node for sum or max operations over tensor dimensions
create_view_operation: create a View IR node to reshape or permute tensor dimensions in the Inductor pipeline
build_fallback_kernel: build a FallbackKernel IR node to wrap aten operators not handled by Inductor lowering
validate_ir_structure: validate the Inductor IR node structure to ensure TensorBox references valid View or StorageBox nodes
